Post 1
📉 Friday's session couldn't hold the week's gains. ASX 200 fell 64.60pts or 0.71% to 9,082.20 — 2.31% below its 52-week high. Materials led the selling. The index still finished the week up 0.68%, but the close tells the real story. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔻 Materials dropped 1.61%, A-REITs lost 1.27%. Utilities bucked the trend, gaining 1.28% — defensive rotation on a risk-off Friday. Nine of eleven sectors closed in the red. #ASX #ausbiz #materials #property

Post 3
📉 PDN cratered 17.59% to AUD 7.17 — the session's sharpest single-stock move by a wide margin. Lendlease wasn't far behind, down 8.43% to AUD 2.28. Two very different businesses, one shared message: sellers in control. #ASX #ausbiz #uranium #property

Post 4
🪙 Gold held at AUD 5,742.28/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6795. Silver at AUD 73.50/oz, platinum AUD 2,242.72/oz. A soft Aussie dollar kept metal prices elevated in local terms even as materials stocks sold off — a disconnect worth watching. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5
ASX sits 2.31% off its 52-week high. The line in the sand is 9,082. Does it hold or does materials pressure drag it lower? Watch gold at AUD 5,742/oz and the USD/AUD 0.6795 cross Monday. Where do you see the index by end of week? #ASX #ausbiz #trading
